description: This source file implements APIs for retrieving process status information of a device, including process count, PID, command, size, priority, CPU time, and state, using the proc filesystem. It manages process instances with singleton pattern, thread safety with mutexes, and provides getter functions for process attributes.

classes.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess
classes.description: Class managing process information and API access for device process status.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of hostIf_DeviceProcess for a given device ID.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::getNumOfProcessEntries
methods.description: Counts total number of processes in the system.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_Command
methods.description: Retrieves the command that started the process.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_Size
methods.description: Retrieves the memory size occupied by the process.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_CPUTime
methods.description: Retrieves the CPU time used by the process.

methods.name: hostIf_DeviceProcess::get_Device_DeviceInfo_ProcessStatus_Process_State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the process.
